title: cEDH Workshop
details: Join us for a laid-back cEDH hangout night built around the competitive side of Magic: The Gathering. This isn’t a tournament—there is no pressure. It’s simply a space to jam high-powered games, try out new decks, test fresh tech, and get real reps in with your favorite lists. Whether you’re tuning a new brew or sharpening your main deck, this is the perfect environment to play, learn, and hang out with other competitive-minded players. Bring your best, keep it friendly, and let’s enjoy some great games together.

title: Lake Forest MTG FNM Commander Slay Pass Friday 6 PM
details: Commander Slay Pass Location - Kingslayer Games Fountain Valley Entry Fee - $13 Event Check-in Time: 6:00 PM Format - Commander What does a Slay Pass entry get me? Each Slay Pass player will receive 3 Magic the Gathering Booster Packs from our selection of Slay Pass-eligible packs (Any pack that is $6.50 or below). Players will only receive their 3 packs after joining the event through the MTG Companion app! Check out our website for the description of our FNM Commander Event! Event Fee Refund Policy: When you register for an event, you agree to these terms. For any cancellation requests, please call the store where the event is being hosted at least 3 hours before the start time of the event. Cancellation requests made within 3 hours of the event start time are not eligible for a refund. For any cancellation requests for an event that starts at or before 12:00 PM, please call the store the day before during opening hours.
